text.content:
Scene: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.scenes.Scene.NVgVH9EvkL8qhFF6]{19. Shadow on the Peaks}

Actors: @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.mhegWCVYQ4D4pOyS]{Ilthuliak (Sighting)}, @UUID[Compendium.points-of-interest.actors.Actor.piSaUnyJLjaaeCN7]{Ilthuliak (Ambush)}

Zone Zone 19: Branthlend Mountains (a ruined dragon roost on a black-rock spire above a fen)
Hex 4.1 on the Stolen Lands map
Type Exploration and sighting before Chapter 10; revenge ambush afterwards
Threat Sighting: no combat. Ambush: Severe 120 at party level 18, Moderate 80 at party level 19.
Creatures Ilthuliak (L21, Kingmaker)

Irovetti's map note. A tall black spire inked in, with a wing shape above it drawn again and again in heavy strokes as though he traced it while thinking. The note reads: "her old roost — empty? if so, mine."

Background. The black dragon Ilthuliak once ruled these peaks. She now spends most of her time in her lair in the First World (Chapter 10, page 454). Every few months she flies over her old haunts. Irovetti wanted her abandoned roost for its acid-etched treasures and sent scouts to watch. They saw her come back once and never set foot there again. The roost still holds a small cache and the fen below it remains poisoned by her Corrupt Water.

Arrival (sighting).

A shadow sweeps across the fen, and the frogs fall silent. High above, a black dragon wheels around a spire of dark rock, her wings scattering mist, a long acid-burned scar visible along one flank. She circles once, twice, and then she climbs into the clouds and is gone.

Arrival (revenge ambush).

The fen water hisses. Something huge slides under the surface toward you, and then Ilthuliak rises in a wave of black water, her scarred head lowered and her eyes fixed on you. "You entered my home," she says. "Now I enter yours."

Features.

  • The spire. A 300-foot black-rock spire. Climbing it is a DC 38 Athletics check; flying is easier. The roost sits on a ledge near the top.
  • The roost. An open cave strewn with bones and acid-scarred metal. Old Pitaxian survey stakes ring the entrance.
  • The fen. Shallow acidic water (difficult terrain; creatures that end a turn submerged take 3d6 acid damage). Ilthuliak swims through it freely.
  • Corrupted pools. Undrinkable water; plants here are dead.

Running the encounter.

Before Chapter 10 (sighting). The PCs glimpse Ilthuliak overhead. Let them track her with a DC 39 Survival check to the roost. The roost lies empty. Searching it reveals her old treasure cache and a fresh scale that a DC 39 Arcana check identifies as touched by First World magic. This foreshadows her lair in Chapter 10.

After the PCs fight her in Chapter 10 (revenge ambush). Ilthuliak hunts the PCs. She ambushes them when they cross the fen. She opens with Breath Weapon down the longest line of PCs, then uses Frightful Presence. She fights from the water, using Tail Lash against anyone who tries to Climb or Recall Knowledge, and flies off to the roost if reduced below 100 HP. If she retreats, the PCs can finish her at the roost.

Outcomes.

  • Sighting. The PCs gain the roost cache and a clue about her First World lair (+2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge about Ilthuliak in Chapter 10).
  • Ambush won. Ilthuliak dies or flees for good. The fen begins to recover within a year.
  • Ambush lost or fled. Ilthuliak keeps hunting the PCs and attacks again within a month.

Rewards. Sighting: 40 XP for finding the roost. Ambush: 120 XP at party level 18. Treasure (roost): 2,000 gp in tarnished coins, a level 16 permanent item corroded but intact. Treasure (ambush): her hoard remains in the First World, but her carried horn ornaments are worth 3,000 gp.

Scaling. At party level 19 or higher, add a black dragon drake or an acid-water hazard to the ambush. If the PCs never reach her First World den, keep the encounter as a sighting.
